title: How to Get Your Guy to Open up
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Linked short stories by Aoi Kujou about men in their twenties and older: Aruto's ex-boyfriend Shouei joins his workplace, Sena tries to move on from Natsuki with Natsuki's friend Sakurai, and Natsuki confesses to art teacher Ichikawa when he hears Ichikawa is resigning (Renta! blurb, MU). Office parties, reunions and a marriage proposal tie the couples together (MU).
life_message: Saying your feelings out loud, even late, is how love becomes real.

content.note: Renta! blurb describes a heated sexual scene in the art room; MU Yaoi with Student-Teacher Relationship and Age Gap; AniList Boys' Love.
Party with lots of alcohol; Drunk/s (MU).
Student-teacher romance (MU); whether Natsuki is still a minor is unconfirmed.
